description:
FILED s473f (Opus, 2026-09-09).  PRE-EXISTING (identical on 0ece3088).

    open(my $fh, ">", $F) or die;
    my $r = print {$$fh} "x\n";

    perl : 1, and "x\n" is written
    PCL  : undef, nothing written

`fileno($$fh)` and `binmode($$fh)` both reach the handle, so the deref itself
resolves; the `:fh` slot of print is the divergent half.  Found while making
lib/IO/Handle.pm's `binmode` stop dereferencing (#1074): core's IO::Handle
writes `$$fh` throughout because its objects are blessed glob REFS, so any
future shim that keeps that spelling will hit this.

Probe scratch/s473f/p5d-deref.pl row 05.
subject: SILENT WRONG: `print {$$fh} ...` writes nothing -- a dereferenced handle in the `:fh` slot
